headline: Nigeria Customs Reports N1.42 Trillion Revenue and $752.8 Million in Q3 Exports
summary: The Nigeria Customs Service generated N1.42 trillion in revenue during September and October 2026. Additionally, the agency processed $752.8 million in exports through its Lilypond Export Command in the third quarter.
why: Customs revenue and export data are key indicators of trade activity and government fiscal health in emerging markets like Nigeria.
